title: diggs-capabilities 1.0
description: What one pydiggs install can do, as pydiggs.capabilities().to_dict() returns it (pydiggs capabilities --json, GET /v1/capabilities, MCP resource pydiggs://capabilities): each operation with its stability, inputs, outputs, options, the extras it needs and whether they are installed. Open for consumers: objects accept unknown fields, so a 1.0 consumer accepts any 1.x document. A new optional field or a new token in inputs, outputs or needs is a minor version; a new stability or option type, or anything else, is a new major.

$schema.description: URL of the schema the document follows.

pydiggs_version.description: The pydiggs version that wrote the document.

operations.description: Every operation this pydiggs offers, available here or not.

id.description: Stable identifier, such as validate, read, ags4.check or export.gpkg.

label.description: What the operation does, in plain language.

inputs.description: What it reads: a DIGGS version (diggs-2.6), an AGS4 version (ags4-4.1.1), a pydiggs document (diggs-model-1.0) or an in-memory Python type.

outputs.description: What it gives: a pydiggs document (diggs-findings-1.1, diggs-model-1.0), a media type (application/geo+json), an AGS4 version or an in-memory Python type (pandas.DataFrame).

options.description: Option name (the keyword argument and request parameter) -> its description.

needs.description: The pydiggs extras it needs (pip install 'pydiggs[gis]'); empty for the core.

available.description: Whether everything it needs is installed in the interpreter that answered.

stability.description: stable follows Semantic Versioning; preview may change in a minor release; experimental may change or go at any time.

type.description: The value type; file is a second file (a path in Python).

label.description: What the option does, in plain language.

default.description: The default; null means not given, and the operation then decides.

choices.description: The values accepted (each item of a string[] option), or null for any.

required.description: Whether the option must be given.
